'''Delta 1''' was a [[Zinsian]] processing center on [[Brosi]], in the area of [[Shoengen]]. It was within the sphere of influence of the [[Brosin Underground]] around [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
